about: The HypnoMix store's catalogue: free plug-ins, instruments and sample content from their publishers' own download pages. Each source was checked on the publisher's site or GitHub releases API when it was added. GitHub sources are resolved when you install, to the newest release asset matching the pattern, and checked against the sha256 GitHub publishes for it (when it publishes one). An item with no fingerprint to check against is installed only after a second, plain-words confirmation that it is not verified. To add an item, copy an entry, fill every field, and run python -m unittest tests.test_store.

left_out.name: x42 plug-ins
left_out.why: free and open source (GPL-2.0+), but macOS builds are sold through the publisher's store; no free direct macOS download

left_out.name: LSP plug-ins
left_out.why: the official releases have Linux and FreeBSD builds only, no macOS

left_out.name: Helm
left_out.why: no release builds on GitHub, and the last macOS build predates Apple Silicon

left_out.name: Bespoke Synth
left_out.why: a stand-alone application, not a plug-in; the store installs plug-ins and sounds only

left_out.name: Hydrogen
left_out.why: a stand-alone drum machine application, not a plug-in, and without MPE

left_out.name: Geonkick
left_out.why: free and open source (GPL-3.0), but its releases have Windows and Linux builds only

left_out.name: DrumGizmo
left_out.why: the macOS download is an old-style VST2 archive with no stated Apple silicon or VST3 and AU support; its kits are here as SFZ ports instead

left_out.name: Decent Sampler
left_out.why: MPE is documented (alpha), but its download sits behind an email form, no size is given, and the plug-in's own licence terms are not stated

left_out.name: Free editions of synths with paid editions
left_out.why: a wavetable synth and a modular rack: their makers sell paid editions under the same name, and neither has release builds the store can fetch (Cardinal, in this store, is the open-source modular plug-in)

left_out.name: A free, cut-down edition of a larger synth
left_out.why: free, but its maker describes it as a teaser for the full one, which is sold

items.name: Surge XT
items.about: A big hybrid synth (subtractive, wavetable, FM) with a full multi-effects section and thousands of presets.
items.mpe_note: The manual documents MPE: switch it on with the MPE button in the header and right-click it to set the bend range; per-note bend, pressure and slide then work as voice modulators.

items.name: Six Sines
items.about: A small synth built on audio-rate modulation between six sine operators (more phase and amplitude modulation than classic FM), with a big modulation matrix.
items.mpe_note: The maker's manual documents MPE: switch it on, and set the bend range, in the MPE section of the settings screen; per-note pressure and slide can then drive its modulation.
items.note: It comes as a disk image. If that holds the maker's installer, the store opens it in Apple's Installer for you to click through, and it may ask for your password. The maker gives the source code an MIT licence but states no licence for the built plug-in.

items.name: JS80P
items.about: A 64-voice synth with two oscillators, a sub-bass sine, filters, effects and macros (subtractive, FM, phase and amplitude modulation). This package installs the VST3 only. Small download.
items.mpe_note: The README documents MPE: in the header of oscillator 1, click the MPE box and choose a lower or an upper zone; each note then follows its own bend, pressure and slide (CC 74).
items.note: An installer package signed by the maker: you click through it in Apple's Installer, and it may ask for your password.

items.name: Overtonium
items.about: A 32-partial additive synth laid out like a mixer, each partial tuned anywhere between equal temperament and pure ratios. A young project.
items.mpe_note: The maker documents MPE, and it is off by default: turn it on in Settings (or the Playing bar); per-note bend and pressure work, and slide moves that note's brightness or its tuning.
items.note: An installer package, signed and notarised by the maker, that lets you choose VST3 and AU; it may ask for your password.

items.name: CA-72
items.about: A synth modelled on the circuit of a 1970s analogue monophonic synth, played mono or with one whole instrument per note (poly). Early version (0.3). The maker's licence is GPL 3 or later.
items.mpe_note: The README documents MPE: each note's pressure, slide (CC 74) and bend move only that note; in Settings, MPE can follow the controller automatically, be set to the lower zone, or be turned off.
items.note: A big installer package (about 130 MB), signed and notarised by the maker; it may ask for your password.

items.name: Resonarium
items.about: A physical-modelling synth built on coupled string waveguides, made to be played with pressure and slide. Feature-complete: the maker now only fixes bugs.
items.mpe_note: The README calls it MPE-compatible and says many presets work best with a controller that sends pressure and slide; it names no switch to turn on.
items.note: The maker warns that an unstable preset can be very loud: turn your volume down before you try new presets.

items.name: Sfizioso Player
items.about: A sample player for SFZ instruments, built on a fork of the sfizz engine that adds MPE. It plays the same SFZ kits and instruments as sfizz. The player is AGPL, its engine BSD 2-clause. A young project.
items.mpe_note: The README and release notes document MPE: in the player, change the MPE mode from Off to Full (it is not switched on for you); per-note bend, pressure and slide (CC 74) then reach the sampled sound.
items.note: The maker does not sign or notarise this build, so macOS blocks it the first time: approve it once in System Settings, Privacy and Security. It was built on an Apple silicon computer, so it is probably Apple silicon only.

items.name: Vaporizer2
items.about: A wavetable, additive and sampler synth with a large preset library, released as free software by its makers in 2023.
items.mpe_note: The release notes mention MPE fixes and some factory presets are made for MPE, but no maker page says how MPE is switched on: try it with your controller.
items.note: A large download (about 640 MB): a zip holding the maker's own installer, whose kind is not known before it is opened, so this one may need installing by hand from the maker's page. No release since March 2024.

items.name: plugdata
items.about: Pure Data with a modern interface, usable as a plug-in: build your own instruments and effects. Large download.
items.mpe_note: Its bundled ELSE library has an [mpe.in] object that turns raw MIDI into per-voice MPE data; there is no ready-made MPE voice, so you build the patch yourself.
items.note: A very large installer package (about 770 MB) that may ask for your password.

items.name: Dexed
items.about: A classic six-operator FM synth; loads that family of FM patch cartridges (sysex).
items.mpe_note: The release notes say MPE support is initial (since 0.9.5); the maker has no page on how to switch it on, so try it with your controller.

items.name: Cardinal
items.about: A modular synth in a plug-in, with over a thousand open-source modules built in and no account needed.
items.mpe_note: Found in the maker's source rather than the README: the Host MIDI modules have an MPE mode, and you patch per-note pitch, pressure and slide yourself.
items.note: Some artwork in its bundled modules is under a non-commercial, no-derivatives or custom licence (the project's README says so): the licence label shown here is still to be checked against it.

items.name: MPE Emulator
items.about: A MIDI plug-in that gives an ordinary keyboard MPE: it applies channel pressure, pitch bend or any control change to one note at a time (lowest, highest, oldest or newest) and sends MPE to the synth after it. Not needed for a controller that already sends MPE.
items.mpe_note: Giving MPE to controllers that lack it is its whole job (README): it turns aftertouch, bend or a control change into per-note expression. It does not turn velocity into pressure or slide.
items.note: Your DAW has to pass a MIDI plug-in's output on to the instrument after it, and not every one does. An installer package signed by the maker; it may ask for your password.

items.name: OB-Xf
items.about: An open-source virtual analog polyphonic synth, the continuation of an earlier open-source synth; it reads that synth's banks. Free in all contexts.
items.note: The stable release this entry installs has no MPE. The maker's nightly builds do, but that is not documented yet.

items.name: OB-Xd
items.about: A virtual analog polyphonic synth in the style of a classic eight-voice analog polysynth. Version 2 is freeware from discoDSP (the old open-source code is a separate project).

items.name: Odin 2
items.about: A 24-voice polyphonic synth: three oscillators, three filters, a modulation matrix and effects.
items.note: This installs the maker's nightly development build, which the maker calls not the stable release; its stable release is a link the store cannot fetch.

items.name: Shortcircuit XT (beta)
items.about: A multi-zone sampler with a modulation matrix and effects, in public beta. The source is MIT; the built plug-in is AGPL.
items.note: A beta with no numbered release: this installs the maker's nightly build, which is replaced almost every day and may have bugs. The source has per-note MPE fields, but the maker has written no user documentation for them.

items.name: sfizz
items.about: The SFZ sample player: plays every SFZ instrument and drum kit in this store.
items.note: The maker has archived both repositories (March 2025); the last release is 1.2.3 (January 2024) and it has no MPE. Sfizioso Player, in this store, is a fork of its engine that adds MPE.

items.name: ChowKick
items.about: A kick drum synth modelled on old drum machine circuits.

items.name: Membrum
items.about: A 32-pad drum synth with no samples: six exciters, six body models, choke groups and 20 factory kits. It answers velocity only (no pressure or slide). Version 0.x.
items.note: Installs for all users in the Mac's main Library, so Apple's Installer asks for your password. This entry is pinned to version 0.12.5 and checked against the maker's fingerprint; it does not move to a newer release by itself.

items.name: Airwindows Consolidated
items.about: Every Airwindows processor in one plug-in: consoles, saturation, tape, dithers, reverbs, EQs.

items.name: Dragonfly Reverb
items.about: Four reverbs: Hall, Room, Plate and Early Reflections. Natural and easy on the CPU.

items.name: CHOW Tape Model
items.about: A physical model of an analog reel-to-reel tape machine: saturation, wow and flutter, loss.

items.name: ChowMatrix
items.about: A tree of analog-style delay lines you grow by clicking: from slapback to strange.

items.name: BYOD (Build Your Own Distortion)
items.about: Guitar and bass distortion built from modules: pedals, amps, cabinets, EQ.

items.name: Valentine
items.about: A compressor and saturator meant to pump and breathe, for drums and buses.

items.name: GATE-12
items.about: A trance gate and volume shaper: draw the pattern, trigger it by tempo, MIDI or audio.

items.name: REEV-R
items.about: A convolution reverb with drawn modulation before and after the reverb (swells, gated tails).
items.note: The maker's own README calls the macOS build untested.

items.name: TIME-12
items.about: A delay whose time follows a drawn envelope: tape stops, stutters, pitch warps.

items.name: FILT-R
items.about: A filter whose cutoff and resonance follow drawn envelopes, by tempo, MIDI or audio.

items.name: Wolf Shaper
items.about: A waveshaper you draw as a curve: soft clipping to wild distortion.

items.name: ZL Equalizer 2
items.about: A parametric EQ with an analyser, high-pass and low-pass filters, shelves, bells, notches and tilt, and dynamic bands with side-chain filters. Apple silicon build. Actively maintained.
items.note: It comes with the maker's installer, which installs for all users in the Mac's main Library, so Apple's Installer asks for your password. The maker says AI tools have helped write it since October 2026.

items.name: ZL Compressor
items.about: A modern compressor with look-ahead, up to 8x oversampling, a side-chain EQ and a clipper stage. Apple silicon build. Version 0.x, actively developed.
items.note: It comes with the maker's installer, which installs for all users in the Mac's main Library, so Apple's Installer asks for your password. Version 0.x.

items.name: master_me
items.about: A one-box mastering chain: gate, EQ, leveler, compressor, multiband mid-side compressor, limiter and stereo correction. Fills the missing multiband stage. The release also carries its source code.
items.note: It comes with the maker's installer, which installs for all users in the Mac's main Library, so Apple's Installer asks for your password. The installer inside the disk image is signed.

items.name: ChowMultiTool
items.about: A bundle of tools in one plug-in: linear-phase and analog-style EQ, steep brickwall filters, a band splitter, a waveshaper and a state-variable filter. Gives the steep high-pass and low-pass that the stock EQ lacks.
items.note: It comes as a disk image with the maker's installer, which the store opens in Apple's Installer for you to click through; it may ask for your password.

items.name: Noise Repellent
items.about: Spectral broadband noise reduction: learn the noise, then take it out. GPL 3 or later.
items.note: An installer package: you click through it in Apple's Installer, and it may ask for your password.

items.name: Real-time Noise Suppression
items.about: A speech noise suppressor built on the RNNoise model. Made for talking, not singing: it can damage a sung vocal.

items.name: AIDA-X
items.about: Plays neural-network models of guitar and bass amps and pedals, plus a cabinet impulse response. GPL 3 or later. The disk image's installer is unsigned: open it with a right-click.
items.note: The maker's installer is not notarised, so macOS refuses it at first: approve it once in System Settings, Privacy and Security (or open it with a right-click). One amp model and one cabinet are included; more are a separate download from the maker.

items.name: QPitch
items.about: Basic pitch correction for vocals, by its own description. A young project. This package installs the VST3 only.

items.name: StftPitchShiftPlugin
items.about: Pitch shifting with formant control, for creative vocal shifts and harmonies. The build is unsigned, so macOS asks you to approve it.
items.note: The maker does not notarise this build, so macOS asks you to approve it in System Settings, Privacy and Security the first time.

items.name: Fire
items.about: A multiband distortion and effects chain: distortion, dynamics, EQ, modulation, delay, reverb, lo-fi and granular blocks, with macros and LFOs. The build is not notarised, so macOS asks you to approve it.
items.note: The maker does not notarise this build, so macOS asks you to approve it in System Settings, Privacy and Security the first time.

items.name: ZAM Plugins
items.about: A set of dynamics and EQ plug-ins: multiband compressors, dynamic EQ, parametric and graphic EQ, gate, tube saturation, maximiser. Large download; which formats the Mac disk image holds is not stated by the maker.
items.note: A large disk image (about 250 MB) holding the whole set; the maker does not say which plug-in formats the Mac version holds.

items.name: Ildaeil
items.about: A plug-in that hosts other plug-ins, CLAP included, inside a VST3 or LV2 plug-in: the way to use CLAP-only plug-ins in a DAW that cannot load CLAP. The hosted plug-in's parameters are not exposed for automation. Not tested with MPE.
items.note: A large download (about 150 MB). The hosted plug-in's own controls cannot be automated from your DAW.

items.name: Salamander Grand Piano V3
items.about: A concert grand piano, 16 velocity layers, SFZ with FLAC samples. Plays in sfizz. The licence asks for a credit (see Credit).
items.credit: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm (CC-BY-3.0): credit it when you release music made with it

items.name: VSCO 2 Community Edition
items.about: A small orchestra: strings, woodwinds, brass, keys and percussion as SFZ instruments. Public domain.

items.name: Versilian Community Sample Library
items.about: Raw WAV samples of hundreds of instruments (percussion, keys, strings, winds, found sounds), with SFZ maps. Public domain.

items.name: MuldjordKit
items.about: An acoustic drum kit with velocity layers and round robins, SFZ with FLAC samples. Plays in sfizz. The licence asks for a credit (see Credit).
items.credit: MuldjordKit by Lars Muldjord (CC-BY-4.0): credit it when you release music made with it

items.name: Big Rusty Drums
items.about: A big, roomy, slightly battered rock kit. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Virtuosity Drums
items.about: A detailed jazz and pop kit with many velocity layers. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: FreePats Synthesizer Percussion
items.about: Drum and percussion sounds in the style of vintage synthesiser music, made with free synths. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: FreePats World Percussion
items.about: Cajon, bongos, congas, egg shakers, tambourines, hand clap, claves, castanets, maracas and darbuka, recorded from real instruments. The sounds are public domain. Plays in sfizz.
items.note: The folder also holds a picture (picture.jpg) that is under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, not public domain: credit its maker if you ever share or publish it. The sounds need no credit.

items.name: FreePats ColomboADK
items.about: A hand-made 1970s-80s drum kit with wooden toms and a piccolo snare. GPL 2 or later with an exception: using the sounds in a song does not make the song GPL. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: FreePats Hang (D minor)
items.about: A hand-played tuned steel instrument in D minor, ten notes (A3 to D5), recorded with the player. A good one-pitch-per-pad sound. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: FreePats Timpani
items.about: Timpani built from the Versilian Community Sample Library. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: FreePats Glass
items.about: A pitched instrument made from tuned glasses of water, about A4 to G6. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Gogodze Phu Vol I
items.about: Five hand drums from Ghana and a cajon with five strike positions, side hits and finger rolls. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Body Percussion
items.about: Claps, slaps and other body-percussion samples, 24-bit stereo, 4 to 6 round robins. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.
items.note: A snapshot of the maker's repository at one fixed commit, not a numbered release: it has no fingerprint, and the real download size is not stated (the size here is the sum of its files).

items.name: Frankensnare
items.about: Thirty snare drums, from small ash snares to a large birch one, one program each. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Swirly Drums
items.about: Brushed drums and percussion: kick, snare, tom, cymbal, hi-hat and percussion buses, as a basic and a full kit program. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.
items.note: A large download (about 870 MB). The zip also holds files for another sample player, which the store ignores; load the .sfz programs in sfizz.

items.name: Unruly Drums
items.about: A kit where every drum, the kick included, has snare wires; sticks, brushes and whole-kit programs. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: The Hat With The Phat
items.about: An oversized hi-hat made from two ride cymbals, with a continuous hi-hat position control (CC 4). Public domain. Plays in sfizz.
items.note: The maker's own page for it still says GPL 3, but the repository and the maker's free-libraries page say CC0, which is what is shown here. A large download (about 670 MB).

items.name: Naked Drums
items.about: A multi-microphone kit: 10 round robins, up to 5 velocity layers, kick, snare, five toms, hi-hats, ride and cymbals, with hi-hat openness on CC 4. The licence asks for a credit (see Credit). Plays in sfizz.
items.note: A snapshot of the maker's repository at one fixed commit, not a numbered release: it has no fingerprint, and the real download size is not stated (the size here is the sum of its files). A large download.
items.credit: Naked Drums by Wilkinson Audio, SFZ version by kinwie (CC-BY-4.0): credit them when you release music made with it

items.name: DRSKit
items.about: A rock and jazz kit: kick, hanging tom, two floor toms, snare, hi-hat, two crashes and a ride. The old stereo version of the DrumGizmo project's kit, made for SFZ players. The licence asks for a credit (see Credit). Plays in sfizz.
items.note: A snapshot of the maker's repository at one fixed commit, not a numbered release: it has no fingerprint, and the real download size is not stated (the size here is the sum of its files). A large download.
items.credit: DRSKit v1.0 by the DrumGizmo team and Jes Eiler of DRSDrums, SFZ version by kinwie (CC-BY-4.0): credit them when you release music made with it

items.name: Black And Blue Basses
items.about: Two electric basses, fingered and picked, with slides and mutes. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Meatbass
items.about: A punchy electric bass. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Weresax
items.about: An alto saxophone in three forms: sax, 'saxcordion' (sax sounds played as an accordion) and 'sxnth' (a polyphonic subtractive synth). Vibrato, tremolo and brightness are on CCs. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Bear Sax
items.about: A baritone saxophone, solo and duo, with five keyswitch articulations and synth-like variants; dynamics and breath noise on the mod wheel. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: War Tuba
items.about: A tuba, solo to trio, legato and poly, with keyswitch articulations and a synth-like variant. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: String Cyborgs
items.about: Bowed double bass and cello samples used as the oscillators of three subtractive synths, with a long list of CC controls. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.

items.name: Horse Pulse
items.about: A bass tagelharpa (a bowed folk instrument) played pizzicato, with pluck, scrape, soft scrape, nail, flam and effect techniques. Public domain. Plays in sfizz.
